qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: While FINN.no maintains strong localized classified network effects in Norway, the consolidated group fails the empirical proof-of-moat hurdle with a 5-year median GAAP ROIC of only 2.5%, sub-15% tangible ROIC, and negative operating income in FY25 (-NOK 166M).
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Rejected – G3 Moat & Pricing). Consolidated entity fails the empirical proof-of-moat hurdle with a 5-year median GAAP ROIC of only 2.5% (and FY25 EBIT of -NOK 166M). Erratic capital efficiency, complex corporate reorganizations, and negative operating margins post-Schibsted demerger fail to demonstrate sustained group-wide pricing power.
qualitative.evidence: 5-year median GAAP ROIC is 2.5% (0.0246) and tangible ROIC median is ~3.4%, far below the 12%/15% hurdles. FY25 EBIT was -NOK 166M with net income of -NOK 184M. Multi-year corporate restructuring following the news media demerger to Tinius Trust and the Adevinta private equity buyout has produced severe earnings volatility and depressed consolidated returns on capital.
